value.name: asks when to call Devin
value.description: Rosa asks Asha when she will call Devin, prompting the next action.
evidence: "So," she said, quiet, "when do you call Devin?"

value.name: sends message to Devin
value.description: Asha ignores the question briefly, opens a new message to Devin, edits it, and sends an invitation to come by that night.
evidence: Asha didn't answer right away; she turned the phone upright in her hand, thumbed past the calendar reminder without dismissing it, and opened a new message to Devin instead.

She typed Can you come by my place tonight, I need to talk to you, read it once, deleted the comma and put a period in, and sent it before she could weigh the word tonight against the word tomorrow any longer.

value.name: states Devin has been contacted
value.description: Asha places the phone down and says 'Now,' signaling that the message has been sent and the waiting has begun.
evidence: Then she set the phone face up on the corrected stack, where the screen would light when he answered, and said, to Rosa or to the table, "Now."

value.name: Rosa leaves the kitchen
value.description: Rosa slowly withdraws from the kitchen toward the hallway, giving Asha space.
evidence: Rosa eased her knuckles off the back of the chair and walked the length of the kitchen toward the doorway, slower than she needed to, the dish towel still folded over her wrist.

value.name: Asha waits for Devin's reply
value.description: Asha watches the unsent-looking thread and waits as the phone remains silent and the calendar reminder continues underneath.
evidence: Asha didn't turn to watch her go; she picked the phone up off the corrected stack, woke the screen, and opened the thread with Devin so the single sent line sat alone at the bottom of the glass.
The typing indicator did not appear.

She held the phone in both hands the way she would hold a brief she was about to file, thumb resting just below the message, and listened to Rosa's footsteps stop in the hall and then start again, leaving her with the stack and the unblinking screen and the calendar reminder still ticking quietly underneath.

value.name: sets phone down and continues waiting
value.description: When the screen dims without any response, Asha stops trying to wake it and leaves the phone face-up on the folder while she waits.
evidence: When the screen finally dimmed without changing, she did not press it back to light; she set the phone face-up on the top folder, where the red X bled faintly through, and waited.
